title: 第九章 我是谁第十章 沈梓语
content_zh:
狄九获得的前世记忆主要集中在语言和所在是一个什么样的世界，对身边许多的人和事，他获得的记忆非常模糊。他也并不清楚前世是喜欢沈梓语还是讨厌沈梓语，只能用模糊的字眼带过去。
“那好啊，我和安琅烧过香了，你跟我们一起回酒店吧。”听到不是沈梓语的事情，梁茜一下子就轻松下来。
梁茜是一个很热心的高中同学，这是梁茜留给狄九的印象。
……
从忘川寺到梁茜所住的县城酒店，有一个多小时的车程。因为狄九看起来像一个流浪汉，在车上倒是吸引了众多的目光。
梁茜对狄子默不陌生，不仅仅是因为狄子默和她是高中同学，更是因为两年前沈梓语和狄子默的婚礼，她去过。
尽管梁茜不知道如此优秀的沈梓语为何要和狄子默结婚，对狄子默和沈梓语离婚，她倒是并不觉得意外。这两个人怎么联系都不会是同一个层次上的，无论是什么原因结婚，不离婚才是怪事。
让梁茜感觉到有些奇怪的是，狄子默比起之前变化了好多。
之前的狄子默给人的感觉有些不爱说话，性格内向懦弱。而今天和狄子默坐车过来两个小时，狄子默问的就没有停过，似乎是没话找话，又似乎是好久没有和人说过话了，想要将所有的话一次性全部说出来。
“狄子默，你有什么需要我帮忙的？”回到真苑酒店后，梁茜开门见山的问道，她都有些受不了狄九的话多，实在是太啰嗦了，难道婚变可以让一个人性格变这么多？
“你们聊，我去帮子默哥买几件衣服吧。”和梁茜一起的安琅主动说道，似乎不大想插到狄九和梁茜的对话中来。
狄九笑道，“谢谢你安琅学弟，衣服等会我自己去买好了。”
“狄子默，真没想到你现在变化这么大。安琅可不是学弟呢，他计算机系的，今年研二了，算是我们的师兄。你还是说你需要我帮你什么事情吧，也许我根本就帮不上忙。”梁茜没好气的白了一眼狄九说道。
之前她还有些同情狄九，现在和狄九一起坐车来酒店，她算是看清楚了，这个狄九绝对不需要她同情，也没有半点精神上的抑郁症。
狄九一点都没有在意，继续说道，“梁茜，我以后改名狄九了，狄子默这个名字代表我的过去和前世。狄九是我的今生，是我的重新开始。”
“好吧，狄九，你到底想要我帮你什么？”梁茜有些无奈的叹了口气，还前世今生。在她看来，不努力永远都一样。
狄九笑了笑，“你也知道，我最近去外面旅游，只是有一次我不小心在一处险地摔到了头，虽然捡回来了一条小命，我很多的记忆都有些模糊。比如刚刚见到你的时候，差点没有认出你来，现在你能不能简单的和我说一下。”
“啊……”梁茜和安琅同时惊啊了一声，两人都被狄九的话惊住了。
好一会梁茜才有些不确定的说道，“难怪我觉得你和以前有些不同，原来是这样，你没事吧，要不要去医院再检查检查？”
狄九自嘲的笑了笑，“你也知道，现在去医院就是钱，我可没有那么多钱，况且现在也不错，至少我忘记了一些本来就不应该记得的东西。这对我，对有些人来说，也都是好事。”

似乎有些赞同狄九的话，梁茜不自觉的点了点头，“你需要我告诉你什么呢？”
“你能知道和我有关的，随便说说吧。没关系，我早放下来了，过去的就已经过去，之所以要你说说，也是想要证明我彻底放下来了。”狄九的话始终是模棱两可。
好在梁茜并没有在意狄九的语气，叹息一声说道，“我和你只是高中同学了两年而已，知道的也有限的很。高二那年你转学到了我们班，然后一直到高三毕业。在学校的你比较沉默，或者说内向吧，不像现在这样话多。
毕业后，我上了大学，你没有考上就离开了学校。直到两年前，我去沈梓语的婚礼，才知道和沈梓语结婚的居然是你，我的高中同学。再后来，我听说沈梓语离婚了，然后没有了你的消息……”
说到这里梁茜倒是有些疑惑的看了看狄九，按理说能和沈梓语结婚，家庭环境应该不错才是。为什么狄九考不上大学后，就没有再读了？同时她也想起了狄九自从和她同学起就很神秘，至少她不知道狄九来自哪里，家里是做什么的，父母是什么人。
狄九摸了摸鼻子，他没有想到自己和梁茜仅仅是一个勉强同学了两年的人。按照梁茜说的，那只能说比路人甲略微熟悉一点。
至于他想要的信息，那是一点都没有得到。
“谢谢你了，梁茜。”狄九站了起来。
“你打算回洛津吗？”见狄九如此干脆的就站了起来，梁茜忍不住多问了一句。
狄九伸了一个懒腰笑道，“对啊，先回洛津看看吧，总比在外面流浪要好些。”
住在洛津他是知道的，皮夹里面有一张房租单，上面地址就是洛津的。
“狄子……狄九……我觉得你现在比之前更阳光一些，过去的就过去了，不要多想。”梁茜忍不住劝说了一句。
狄九哈哈一笑说道，“对啊，要死卵朝上，都这样了，我还有什么好怕的。颓废下去，只是让我恨的人畅快而已。”
“那你有什么打算吗？”
“这几年我跟着一个采药人学了一点药材知识，准备去看看能不能找一个相关的工作。这次谢谢你了，将我带回来。”狄九说完这句话后，已是走出了梁茜的房间。
报仇的事情很遥远，首先他要自己活下来。余建夫给了一张名片给他，实在不行，他就去临川爱博医院找个工作。在这之前，他先去洛津自己住的地方看看。
……
从忘川县城车站坐车到洛津要四个多小时，尽管狄九有些许模糊的记忆，当他进入洛津后，心里很是感叹，比起明珠城，洛津的人实在是太多了。
不但人多，还极为繁华。如果一定要说比不上明珠城的，那就是洛津没有各类飞行器，也许这里的科技水平比明珠城要差一点。
狄九摸出一张折叠的房租交纳单，上面的地址是洛津武川区学湖路726弄22号601号。因为还有一个名字狄子默，让狄九肯定这个地址应该就是前世他住的地方。

六楼是顶楼，门一打开狄九就闻到了一股淡淡的霉味。抬头看看天花板都被雨水浸湿了，应该是这个顶楼的防水做的不是很好。
漏水不漏水狄九根本就没有心思去管，他第一件事就是将自己彻底清洗了一遍，然后继续睡觉。
从挖出灰色石头，到一道金色闪电帮他改变了身体，再从曲小树那里听到狄家噩耗，然后逃进虚空之中，来到这个地方……
整个过程中，狄九的精神都是一直紧绷着。就是在俞建夫的车上和忘川寺外，他也只是半睡着状态，直到现在才真正的算是有了一些安全保障。

content_en:
Di Jiu's past life memories mainly focused on language and what kind of world he was in. His memories of many people and things around him were very vague. He didn't know whether he liked Shen Ziyu or hated Shen Ziyu in his previous life, so he could only convey it in vague words.
"Okay, An Lang and I have burned incense. You can come back to the hotel with us." Liang Qian relaxed immediately when she heard that it was not Shen Ziyu's matter.
Liang Qian was a very enthusiastic high school classmate. This was the impression Liang Qian left on Di Jiu.
…
It takes more than an hour's drive from Wangchuan Temple to the county hotel where Liang Qian lives. Because Di Jiu looked like a homeless man, he attracted a lot of attention in the car.
Liang Qian was no stranger to Di Zimo, not only because Di Zimo and she were high school classmates, but also because she had been to Shen Ziyu and Di Zimo's wedding two years ago.
Although Liang Qian didn't know why such an excellent Shen Ziyu wanted to marry Di Zimo, she was not surprised that Di Zimo and Shen Ziyu divorced. No matter how these two people relate, they will never be on the same level. No matter what the reason is for getting married, it would be weird not to get divorced.
What made Liang Qian feel a little strange was that Di Zimo had changed a lot compared to before.
Before, Di Zimo seemed a bit reticent, introverted and cowardly. And today, after two hours of driving with Di Zimo, Di Zimo didn't stop asking questions. He seemed to be looking for something to say, and it seemed that he hadn't talked to anyone for a long time and wanted to say everything at once.
"Di Zimo, what do you need my help with?" After returning to Zhenyuan Hotel, Liang Qian asked straight to the point. She couldn't stand Di Jiu's talk. He was too verbose. Could a marriage change change a person's personality so much?
"You guys chat, I'll go buy some clothes for Brother Zimo." An Lang, who was with Liang Qian, said proactively, as if he didn't want to get involved in the conversation between Di Jiu and Liang Qian.
Di Jiu smiled and said, "Thank you, Junior An Lang. I will buy the clothes later."
"Di Zimo, I didn't expect you to change so much now. An Lang is not a junior. He is in the Computer Science Department and is in his second year of graduate school this year. He is considered our senior. You should just say you need me to help you with something. Maybe I can't help you at all." Liang Qian rolled her eyes at Di Jiu angrily and said.
She had some sympathy for Di Jiu before, but now she and Di Jiu came to the hotel by car, she could see clearly that this Di Jiu definitely did not need her sympathy, and he did not have any mental depression.
Di Jiu didn't care at all and continued, "Liang Qian, I will change my name to Di Jiu from now on. The name Di Zimo represents my past and previous life. Di Jiu is my current life and my new beginning."
"Okay, Di Jiu, what do you want me to help you with?" Liang Qian sighed helplessly, returning to her past life. In her opinion, nothing will ever be the same without effort.
Di Jiu smiled and said, "As you know, I was traveling recently, but once I accidentally fell on my head in a dangerous place. Although I saved a small life, many of my memories are a bit blurry. For example, when I just met you, I almost didn't recognize you. Can you briefly tell me now."
"Ah..." Liang Qian and An Lang were startled at the same time. They were both shocked by Di Jiu's words.
After a while, Liang Qian said with some uncertainty, "No wonder I think you are a little different from before. It turns out that's the case. Are you okay? Do you want to go to the hospital for another check-up?"
Di Jiu smiled mockingly, "As you know, going to the hospital is all about money now. I don't have that much money, and it's not bad now. At least I've forgotten some things that I shouldn't have remembered in the first place. This is a good thing for me and some people."
Seemingly agreeing with Di Jiu's words, Liang Qian nodded unconsciously, "What do you need me to tell you?"
"Can you know and meFeel free to talk about it. It doesn't matter, I have let it go a long time ago, and the past is in the past. The reason why I want you to talk about it is to prove that I have completely let it go. "Di Jiu's words are always ambiguous.
Fortunately, Liang Qian didn't care about Di Jiu's tone and sighed, "You and I have only been high school classmates for two years, and our knowledge is very limited. In your sophomore year of high school, you transferred to our class and stayed there until you graduated in your senior year of high school. In school, you were relatively silent, or introverted, and not as talkative as you are now.
After graduation, I went to college, but you left school without passing the exam. It wasn't until two years ago, when I went to Shen Ziyu's wedding, that I knew it was you, my high school classmate, who was marrying Shen Ziyu. Later, I heard that Shen Ziyu got divorced, and then there was no news about you..."
At this point, Liang Qian looked at Di Jiu with some doubts. Logically speaking, if she could marry Shen Ziyu, her family environment should be good. Why didn’t Di Jiu stop studying after he failed the college entrance examination? At the same time, she also remembered that Di Jiu had been very mysterious since he was her classmate. At least she didn't know where Di Jiu came from, what his family did, and who his parents were.
Di Jiu touched his nose. He did not expect that he and Liang Qian were just classmates who had barely been classmates for two years. According to what Liang Qian said, it can only be said that she is slightly more familiar than a passerby.
As for the information he wanted, he didn't get it at all.
"Thank you, Liang Qian. "Di Jiu stood up.
“Are you planning to go back to Luojin? "Seeing Di Jiu standing up so simply, Liang Qian couldn't help but ask one more question.
Di Jiu stretched and smiled, "Yes, let's go back to Luojin first, it's better than wandering outside. "
He knew that he lived in Luojin. There was a rent bill in his wallet, and the address on it was Luojin's.
"Di Zi... Di Jiu... I think you are brighter now than before. The past is in the past, don't think too much about it. "Liang Qian couldn't help but persuade.
Di Jiu laughed and said, "Yes, even if the egg is dead, it's like this. What else do I have to be afraid of? If I continue to be decadent, I will just make the people I hate happy. "
"Then what are your plans? "
"In the past few years, I have learned a little knowledge about medicinal materials from an herb collector, and I am going to see if I can find a related job. Thank you this time for bringing me back. "After Di Jiu finished saying this, he walked out of Liang Qian's room.
Revenge is far away, first he has to survive on his own. Yu Jianfu gave him a business card, but if it didn't work, he went to Linchuan Aibo Hospital to find a job. Before that, he first went to see where Luo Jin lived.
…
It takes more than four hours to take a bus from Wangchuan County Station to Luojin. Although Di Jiu has some vague memories, when he entered Luojin, he sighed in his heart. Compared to Pearl City, there were too many people in Luojin.
Not only is there a lot of people, it is also extremely prosperous. If it must be said that it is not as good as Pearl City, it would be that Luojin does not have various types of aircraft, and perhaps the technological level here is a little worse than that of Pearl City.
Di Jiu took out a folded rent payment slip. The address on it was No. 601, No. 22, Lane 726, Xuehu Road, Wuchuan District, Luojin. Because there was another name, Di Zimo, Di Jiu was sure that this address should be where he lived in his previous life.
The sixth floor was the top floor, and Di Jiu smelled a faint musty smell as soon as he opened the door. When I looked up, I saw that the ceiling was soaked by the rain. It must be that the waterproofing of the attic was not very good.
Di Jiu didn't care whether the water was leaking or not. The first thing he did was to clean himself thoroughly and then go back to sleep.
From digging out the gray stone, to a golden lightning that helped him change his body, to hearing the bad news about the Di family from Qu Xiaoshu, and then escaping into the void and coming to this place...
Throughout the whole process, Di Jiu's spirit remained tense. It was in Yu Jianfu’s car with WangchuanOutside the temple, he was only half asleep, and it was only now that he really had some security.
